reviewer_notes: Article Seventeen B (PERSONAL AND ACADEMIC FREEDOM) protects political activity: 'Religious or lawful political activities of a teacher conducted outside duty hours and off school property shall not be grounds for disciplinary action or for discrimination with respect to the teacher's professional employment', plus the companion no-action pledge by both parties; Article Eighteen C (PDF page 27) adds the restriction that Association material in teacher mailboxes 'shall not relate to local, state or national political matters'. Both quotes are verbatim, but the clause is on PDF page 26 (printed footer '25' - footers run one behind the PDF page), so A's page 25 is wrong while B's page 26 is right; B also correctly notes the mailbox restriction.
